text: Why I don't think the victim will be found alive 11 days after disappearance. 1) To begin with, this is a home invasion and NOT a kidnapping. Kidnappers don't attack and bloody their victims. The victim's blood was found infront of the door. They want to keep them safe and calm to get their ransom money. And they provide proof of life to get the money as soon as possible. They don't like to hang out with their victim especially with an 84 year old woman with serious health problems that requires a lot of care. 2) The guy infront of the door doesn't look like a professional kidnapper. We saw him doing dumb stuff on the video. 3) Smart criminals were acting like fake kidnappers writing ransom notes to collect money without proof of life. The daughter was willing to pay 6 million dollars, but the so-called kidnappers couldn't provide proof of life. Because they don't have the victim's body. 4) What happened was a home invasion and for whatever reason, the victim was killed during the invasion. And the criminals had to take the victim's body and dumb it and burn it somewhere to hide evidence because the body is an evidence. Conclusion : A home invasion has occurred and the victim was killed during the invasion. And body was taken to hide evidence. It is highly likely this crime will be a cold case unless luck and good detective work breaks the case.
